Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 4 Newtown North and Camperdown

Clause 9.4.1 - heritage (heritage_protection): The precinct contains three Heritage Conservation Areas being the Camperdown Park Estate Heritage Conservation Area, North Kingston Estate Heritage Conservation Area and the Hopetoun-Roberts-Federation Streets Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.4.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.4.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.4.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.4.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original built form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.4.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect significant streetscapes and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.4.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly medium density residential character of the precinct.
